description: PAID $0.01 (x402, USDC on Base or Solana). Gap table for up to 60 trade.xyz stock perps (tickers=all for every auto-discovered US stock perp): perp mark/oracle vs reference stock price and Solana xStock, basis, hourly and annualized funding, open interest. Set venues='all' for a cross-venue comparison: trade.xyz vs Aster vs Lighter mark prices, gap % between venues, and each venue's funding (hourly and annualized).

tickers.description: Comma-separated tickers or 'all', max 60 per call, e.g. NVDA or NVDA,TSLA. Defaults to 20 large names.

venues.description: 'all' adds the trade.xyz vs Aster vs Lighter comparison
